clue.text: Statement delivered in confidence

parts.note: read as a whispered secret, but 'confidence' is faith: a declaration made out of belief

explanation.surface: Someone passes on a remark privately, trusting it goes no further.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In confidence' suggests secrecy; here it means 'in a spirit of trust or faith', which is what a declaration of belief is.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal declaration of belief, from the Latin for 'I believe', is a statement made in faith.

clue.text: A union made in heaven

parts.note: reads as a perfect marriage; really a pair of twins placed together among the stars

explanation.surface: A perfect marriage.
explanation.walkthrough: The Gemini twins of Greek myth were set in the sky as a constellation, a pairing literally made in the heavens.
explanation.definitionFit: The heavenly twins of Gemini form a pair joined in the night sky.

clue.text: Printing unit has trouble in communication

parts.note: an em is a unit of measure in printing
to ail is to trouble

explanation.surface: A printing press component breaks down, causing a breakdown in messages.
explanation.definitionFit: An electronic message sent between computers is a form of communication.

clue.text: Millions taken from amplest source of showy feathers

indicators.note: taken from means removed from the next word's synonym

parts.note: amplest could be rendered most rich

explanation.surface: Millions are drawn from the richest supply of fancy plumes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Amplest' becomes the two words MOST RICH; removing M leaves the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The large flightless bird's plumes were prized for fans and hats, so it supplies showy feathers.

clue.text: The setter, to me, is indicated by the previous clue

definitions.meaning: the setter speaking of themself: the phrase for oneself, looking after one's own interests
the clue before this one is numbered 1

explanation.surface: A setter boasts that the clue just before points straight to them.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for oneself is the same phrase as the label of clue 1, which this clue follows.

clue.text: Biblical sailor Jonah, starting off in a storm

indicators.note: in a storm means tossed about, so the letters are rearranged
starting off means the starting letter is taken off

explanation.surface: Jonah, the biblical prophet, sets out in a tempest.
explanation.walkthrough: Jonah is the wrong sailor: 'starting off' removes his J and 'in a storm' rearranges ONAH.
explanation.definitionFit: The builder of the ark in Genesis sailed through the Flood, a biblical seafarer.

clue.text: Island nation where crazed chief has left mark

parts.note: crazed means mad
an aga is a Turkish chief or commander
a scar is a mark left by a wound

explanation.surface: A country where an insane leader has left his mark.
explanation.definitionFit: The large island republic off Africa's east coast is an island nation.

clue.text: Lavishly coat corrosion below middle of fence

indicators.note: below places the corrosion under, after, the other piece in a down answer
the middle of the word fence is everything but its first and last letters

parts.note: rust is corrosion of iron

explanation.surface: Rust spreading under the centre of a fence.
explanation.definitionFit: To cover something with a thick decorative crust or layer is to coat it lavishly.

clue.text: Potential problem with bank, concerning reinforcement

parts.note: over means concerning, as in a row over money
a draft is a body of troops sent as reinforcement

explanation.surface: Worries about reinforcing a riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bank' suggests a river; it is the bank holding your money.
explanation.definitionFit: Spending more than is in your account brings trouble with your bank.

clue.text: Men give prisoner up — it's blooming late in the day

definitions.text: it's blooming late in the day

indicators.note: up means stirred up, so the letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Men release a prisoner, and the result is a blooming late twist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Up' shuffles MEN GIVE PRISONER; 'blooming' seems an oath but means flowering.
explanation.definitionFit: This yellow-flowered plant opens its blooms in the evening, so it flowers late in the day.

clue.text: Sting odd fellow for financial authorisation

parts.note: to sting is to smart with pain
a card is an eccentric, amusing person

explanation.surface: A con trick played on an eccentric to get money approved.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sting' looks like a con trick (a noun), but it is the verb meaning to hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: A chipped plastic card authorises payments, so it is a means of financial authorisation.

clue.text: Where some train operators come to end of line

definitions.text: Where some train operators come to end of line

parts.note: the people running a train are its crew

indicators.note: the end of the word line is its final letter

explanation.surface: A railway town where drivers' shifts terminate.
explanation.walkthrough: CREWE is a famous railway junction town in Cheshire, England, where many train crews change over; 'end of' picks the final letter of 'line'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cheshire town is a major railway junction where train staff finish or change shifts.

clue.text: What may be boring painting clothes

parts.note: an oil is a painting in oil paint
rig is informal for an outfit of clothes

explanation.surface: Asks what dull thing might be wearing painting overalls.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Boring' seems to mean dull; it means drilling, which an offshore drilling platform does.
explanation.definitionFit: A drilling platform bores into the seabed for petroleum, so it is something that bores.

clue.text: Mass movement putting around Auden is good

indicators.note: putting the letters around means rearranging them into a new order

explanation.surface: A crowd's agitation spreads the word that the poet Auden is fine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mass movement' suggests a popular uprising, but it is a section of the Catholic Mass in church music; 'putting around' is the signal to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: The 'Lamb of God' prayer is a standard section of the musical setting of the Catholic Mass.

clue.text: Hasten to contain convict's tirade in a scandalous way

indicators.note: to contain means the first word's synonym holds the others

parts.note: to fly is to hasten
a lag is a convict, in British slang an old lag
a rant is a tirade

explanation.surface: Rushing to stop a prisoner's outrageous outburst.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something openly and shamefully is acting in an outrageous, scandalous manner.

clue.text: Old stager turned out such easy learner

indicators.note: turned out signals the letters coming out in a different arrangement

parts.note: L is the learner sign, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: An old actor proved to be a surprisingly quick study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old stager' suggests a veteran; it is an ancient Greek dramatist who staged plays.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Athenian tragedian staged plays, so he is literally an old stager.

clue.text: One involved in scrap, namely Emma Peel?

parts.note: sc, short for scilicet, means namely
Emma Peel was one of The Avengers in the 1960s British TV series

explanation.surface: Asks whether Emma Peel was one who fought.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scrap' looks like a fight, suited to Emma Peel; it is scrap material, what a scrounger picks through.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who picks through refuse for usable items is involved with scrap.

clue.text: Strong smell is about with nasal effect

indicators.note: about means surrounding here, the smell going round the other piece

parts.note: a tang is a sharp, strong smell or taste

explanation.surface: A pungent odour reaches the nose.
explanation.definitionFit: A nasal tone in speech is called this, so it is a nasal effect.

clue.text: Sleepy, perhaps, and extremely deaf, staying outside conflict

indicators.note: staying outside says the first piece sits round the other
extremely picks out the extreme letters, first and last, of the word deaf

parts.note: war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: Someone drowsy and very hard of hearing keeps clear of a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: Sleepy is one of the seven dwarfs in the Snow White story; 'perhaps' marks him as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleepy is one of Snow White's seven little companions, an example of the group.

clue.text: Greater part of crew cut for US aircraft-carrier

definitions.meaning: a short haircut whose top is cut level, the main part of a crew cut
American slang for a carrier, from its flat deck

explanation.surface: Most of a sailor's haircut is what a US carrier deck looks like.
explanation.definitionFit: The flat-topped haircut and the American nickname for a carrier with a flat deck share the name.

clue.text: Fighter willing Roman one attaining a peak?

parts.note: glad means willing, as in glad to help
I is one in Roman numerals
a tor is a rocky hilltop

explanation.surface: A keen Roman fighter scales a summit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Roman' seems to describe the fighter but belongs with 'one' as the numeral I.
explanation.definitionFit: Roman arena combatants were swordsmen who fought for spectators, so the word is a kind of fighter.

clue.text: Dull instinctive impulses by means of drink at first

indicators.note: at first puts the preceding pieces at the front

parts.note: in means by means of, as in written in ink
to sip is to drink
the id is the part of the mind holding instinctive impulses

explanation.surface: Instinctive urges dulled by having a drink first.
explanation.definitionFit: Something insipid lacks flavour or interest, so it is dull.

clue.text: Headgear that can be altered to flatter profile

definitions.text: Headgear that can be altered to flatter profile

parts.words: Headgear that can be altered to flatter profile
parts.note: seems to be about a becoming hat; really a tall hat that collapses flat, giving a flatter profile

explanation.surface: A hat that can be adjusted to make the wearer look good side-on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flatter' reads as a verb (to compliment); it is the comparative 'more flat'.
explanation.definitionFit: A collapsible top hat, the gibus, folds flat, so it can take on a flatter outline.

clue.text: Retreat with a pretence to cross river

indicators.note: to cross means the first pieces lie across, around, the river letter

parts.note: a sham is a pretence

explanation.surface: Someone falls back while pretending to ford a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retreat' looks like a verb of withdrawal; it is a noun, a place of religious retreat.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu hermitage or religious community is a place of spiritual retreat.

clue.text: Broad regret, when speaking of this setter

indicators.note: when speaking means the word for regret is said out loud, not spelt

parts.note: to rue is to regret
of me, the setter, is the possessive my

explanation.surface: A setter speaks of broadly regretting something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'When speaking' applies to RUE, giving its sound-alike ROO; 'of this setter' is the setter's own possessive.
explanation.definitionFit: Something spacious is wide and broad.

clue.text: Down a ball at snooker

definitions.meaning: snooker has a ball of this colour, worth five points

explanation.surface: Losing a ball at snooker.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling down is feeling sad, and one snooker ball is coloured this way.

clue.text: Eminent person that's not profound

explanation.surface: A celebrity who turns out to be rather shallow.
explanation.definitionFit: A notable figure is a leading light, and light also means trivial or not serious.

clue.text: Distant shooter bags over half jumbos, in toto

indicators.note: in places the shortened animals inside the word toto

parts.note: the word toto is taken as written

indicators.note: over half keeps the first five of the nine letters, a little more than half the word

parts.note: jumbos are elephants

explanation.surface: A hunter far off kills most of a herd of elephants entirely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Over half' keeps the front five letters of the synonym for jumbos; 'shooter' is a camera, not a hunter, and 'bags' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-focus camera lens shoots pictures of distant subjects, so it is a distant shooter.

clue.text: Finally abandoned export they manufactured in the plant

indicators.note: manufactured means made up, so the letters are put together afresh
the final letter of export is abandoned, dropped

explanation.surface: Goods made in the factory were left unsent at last.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Finally abandoned' drops the T of EXPORT; 'manufactured' shuffles EXPOR + THEY; 'plant' looks like a factory but is a living plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A plant adapted to very dry conditions, such as a cactus, is a botanical term for a kind of plant.

clue.text: Detective story perpetrator? To solve, see back

parts.note: to do a puzzle is to solve it

indicators.note: back means the word for the see is read backwards

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city and bishop's see in England

explanation.surface: A whodunit asks who committed the crime, and tells you to check the back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perpetrator' suggests the criminal; it is the author who perpetrated the stories, Arthur Conan Doyle, creator of Sherlock Holmes.
explanation.definitionFit: Arthur Conan Doyle wrote the Sherlock Holmes stories, so he perpetrated detective fiction.
